script:
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --quiet --check agent.llm.model eq openai/qa-f09-ws --check agent.llm.usage_id eq qa-f09-ws --save F09.restart-persist/cid
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$AID" --quiet --check agent.acp_model eq opus --check current_model_id eq opus --save F09.restart-persist/aid
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$PID" --query include_skills=true --quiet \
  --check agent.agent_context.skills contains qa-f09-mkt-plugin-skill --check hook_config.user_prompt_submit len-eq 1 --save F09.restart-persist/pid
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RID" --quiet --check agent.llm.model eq deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --check agent.llm.usage_id eq profile:deepseek-pro
control-agent-server conversation send "$RID" --text 'Reply with the single word: ok' --wait --until finished,error --timeout 240
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$RID" --until-ok 60 --quiet --check execution_status eq finished \
  --check 'stats.usage_to_metrics.profile:deepseek-pro.accumulated_token_usage.prompt_tokens' gt "$PRO1" --save F09.restart-persist/rid-stats
